snippet.description:
Where does Physical Geography begin? With the Universe.

In Lecture 1 of the GS Foundation 2028 program, Akhilesh Shrivastava introduces the fundamentals of Physical Geography through the study of our Universe.

This lecture lays the foundation for understanding the Earth, its place in the larger cosmic system and the geographical concepts that follow.

Start your Physical Geography preparation with Lecture 1 of GS Foundation 2028.

Apply For Rs.50,000 Scholarship:  https://www.levelupias.com/scholarship-test-for-upsc-gs-foundation/

https://www.levelupias.com/upsc-aarambh/
